definitions.explanation: Walking quickly with purpose and energy. Suggests determination or urgency in one's gait.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すたすた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{怒|おこ}って→怒る：00876_okoru⟧すたすた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{去|さ}って→去る：02115_saru⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、すたすた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: Since I was short on time, I walked briskly toward the station.

notes:
すたすた is a mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) describing walking with quick, purposeful, determined steps. It suggests brisk, energetic movement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (quotative particle) before verbs:
- すたすた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk briskly
- すたすた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go quickly

USAGE:
- Quick, light, purposeful steps
- Often implies determination or being in a hurry
- Can suggest leaving in frustration or anger
- Movements are smooth and efficient
- ⟦{怒|おこ}って→怒る：00876_okoru⟧すたすた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧: to storm off angrily
- ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧すたすた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk briskly because one is in a hurry
- すたすた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to walk ahead quickly

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とぼとぼ→とぼとぼ：05839_tobotobo⟧: walking wearily, slowly, dejectedly (opposite energy)
- ⟦てくてく→てくてく：05838_tekuteku⟧: walking steadily at a moderate pace
- ⟦さっさと→さっさと：05795_sassato⟧: quickly, hurriedly (emphasizes speed over manner)
- ⟦のろのろ→のろのろ：05162_noronoro⟧: slowly, sluggishly

The sound mimics the rhythm of quick footsteps.
